build: lean, defined shoulders from studio work, small-boned wrists
hair: black, straight with a slight natural wave, worn in a low ponytail most days or loose past her shoulders when she's not thinking about it
complexion: warm ivory with golden undertones, a small beauty mark just above her left collarbone
face: heart-shaped with high, prominent cheekbones and a soft mouth that betrays every feeling before her brain catches up—the face of someone who has never learned to hide
signature_feature: her eyes—large, dark brown, almost liquid when she's moved, capable of going shiny with tears in seconds; the LI notices how they widen fractionally when she's about to say something true
second_celebrated_feature: her hands—long-fingered, precise from years of design work, with a habit of gesturing when she talks; he watches them shake slightly when she's afraid
signature_habits: takes her coffee black and scalding, always in the same chipped ceramic mug from a Seoul café her grandmother visited; bites the inside of her cheek when concentrating; texts in full sentences with proper punctuation even to close friends; hums while working—old Korean lullabies her mother sang, unconsciously, without realizing she's doing it
occupation: independent textile and interior designer, runs a small studio in a converted warehouse loft where she sources sustainable fabrics and takes custom commissions for high-net-worth clients

current_crisis.event: her largest client—a billionaire's wife—has publicly accused Mina of stealing a signature design concept and is threatening a lawsuit that could destroy her studio's reputation and her ability to secure future contracts
current_crisis.hottest_emotion: panic, raw and unfiltered—the sense that something she built with her own hands is being taken from her
current_crisis.immediate_want: to make the client understand the truth, to be believed, to not lose everything

wound.core: she has never felt solid enough to deserve good things—success, love, stability—and believes at her core that she will always be the one left behind or found wanting
wound.surfacing_hint: when challenged or accused, she crumbles inward first, her voice going small; she apologizes reflexively even when she's done nothing wrong; she assumes people will eventually see through her and leave
